Rare Net._note: THE MISSING SIBLING. This file already netted Normal and Magic gear at AreaLevel >= 68; Rare had nothing, so a rare whose base is not among Rare Equipment's 643 curated BaseTypes fell through the entire tree to the [99999] green catch-all. Found in game on a 寒光刺剑 / Pecoraro (drop 62) — one of 17 equipment bases out of 1005 that no BaseType line names. Patching those 17 would fix today and re-open the moment GGG adds a base, which is exactly how this one got in; a class net closes it permanently. ⚠️ Rung 3, not 4: this category's theme has only Tier 3 and Tier 5 rows, and a MISSING row inside an existing category falls back to {} rather than to Default - the block emitted a bare SetFontSize 32 with no plate. Tier 3 is also correctly louder than the magic net's Tier 5.
